reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides configurable local Web Audio notifications for agent lifecycle events, with custom sounds and persisted browser settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体生命周期事件提供可配置的本地 Web Audio 提示音，并支持自定义铃声和浏览器本地设置保存。
summaries.en: Provides configurable local Web Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness agent lifecycle events, with custom sounds and browser-persisted settings.

capabilities: Plays configurable Web Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness agent lifecycle events
Stores notification settings and custom audio files locally in browser storage
Provides an optional package update action for the installed plugin
